completion_gate: provenance.json exists and every entry carries a sha256 or an explicit unretrieved reason
each of Q1, Q2, Q3 carries a verdict from the declared enum plus a locus citation
no adjudication rests on unverified recollection
constraints: Never fabricate a command, output, timing, statistic, citation, or run (AGENTS.md rule 9).

Every retrieved source records url, http_status, retrieved_at (UTC), sha256, and byte size. A source that could not be retrieved is recorded as unretrieved with its error, never paraphrased from memory.

Recollection is not evidence. A claim of the form 'I recall this is known' may be recorded only as an explicitly labelled unverified recollection, and may never adjudicate a finding in either direction.
Toy/estimate-tier results never become crypto-scale claims (AGENTS.md rule 7). No ML-KEM break claim.
Write only inside the declared write_scope. Do not edit prior batch artifacts or any ledger record.
Vendored source bytes go under inputs/MLKEM-DUAL-SOURCES-20260802/ ONLY. Do not modify experiments/EXP-MLKEM-010/vendor-lock/, which is an immutable run artifact.
Large binaries: record provenance and the extracted text/region actually used; do not commit a multi-megabyte PDF when the adjudication needs one table.

The comparison baseline is the exact artifact the finding was derived from (hal-05406481). State the revision identifier of BOTH sides of every comparison; a finding cannot be adjudicated against an unidentified revision.
If a source is unreachable, record it as unretrieved and continue -- an unreachable source is an infrastructure fact, never evidence for or against a finding (AGENTS.md rule 5).

Priority order: (1) ePrint 2022/1750 current revision (Carrier-Meyer-Hilfiger-Shen-Tillich) including its revision history, checked against the vendored HAL copy hal-05406481 the findings were derived from; (2) NIST FIPS 203; (3) Ducas-Pulles (ePrint 2023/302) on the dual-attack heuristics; (4) MATZOV 2022 report; (5) Guo-Johansson dual attack. Then answer three adjudication questions, each with a verdict from {confirmed_in_current_source, corrected_by_authors, contradicted, unretrievable, indeterminate} and a quoted locus: Q1 does the Table C.2 CN/Kyber-512 log2(Tsample)=143.30 cell still read 143.30 in the current revision; Q2 does the Pwrong=FFT/k_fft vs Pgood=raw score-scale asymmetry still hold at the current head of kevin-carrier/CodedDualAttack; Q3 does any retrieved source report Pwrong at or near the aligned Pgood operating threshold, i.e. the residual measurement KN-OPEN-016 names.
